notes: BIRTH YEAR/PLACE CORRECTED (research 2026-07-03): Geni ("Henry Paullin, Jr.") and WikiTree (Pawlin-7) both independently document his death (1723, Pilesgrove, Salem Co., NJ) and wife (Sarah Sandford/Sanford) matching this tree exactly, but give his birth as circa 1650 in Padbury, Buckinghamshire, England — not this tree's "1644, ENGLAND." No source found this pass corroborates the claimed father, "HENRY Sr. PAULIN Captain, Immigrant" (I182541964570, 1620-1656, Buckinghamshire to Pasquotank, NC) — that link appears to be a conflation with an unrelated Pasquotank Palin/Paulin family (see that record's note).
